observations: Black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' branding on the top right.
The lens barrel shows 'NIKKOR 18-55' and 'AF-S NIKKOR'.
The camera is held by a hand, suggesting it is being carried or inspected.
A watermark 'POSTED BY JIJI KOMONE ZOE' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The lens may be a generic or lower-quality replacement lens.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens glass with the front element removed.

risks.risk: The camera may have internal electronic faults or a dead sensor.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and the screen displaying a clear image.

risks.risk: The shutter count may be significantly higher than the 5,000 mark.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo taken by the camera.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high shutter count

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the lens glass with the front element removed to verify it is the original lens.
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
